title: Opening Rules of the Twin-Board Thrower
summary: Opens the school's twin-board casting to a Warrior, with parallel grips, alternating casts and its founding paired dart.

title: Hawk-Cry Dart Manual of the Basin Court
summary: Teaches casting timed to a hawk-like cry that startles the foe, ending in the school's great cry-and-dart.

title: River-Reed Casting Discipline
summary: Trains stalking and casting among river reeds, hidden by stems and rustle, ending in a silent dart.

title: Azure Sky Casting Canon of the Paired Hands
summary: Drills the thrower's two hands as a pair, with matched casts, overhead lobs and the school's measured pair.

title: Great Treatise on the Azure Dart Arc
summary: Sets out the full science of the dart's arc for a Xiantian thrower, ending in the school's perfect arc.

title: Book of the Core Dart and the Twin Horizons
summary: Teaches a Core thrower to cast to two horizons at once, drawing the dart's power from the formed core.

title: First Oath-Book of the Plateau Thrower
summary: Gives a Warrior the first oath of the plateau thrower, with bearings, wind-leaning casts and a sworn dart.

title: Wind-Sworn Casting Manual of the Open Ground
summary: Teaches wind-sworn casting on open ground, against charges and counter-volleys, ending in a dart given to the wind.

title: Treatise on the Bearing Held Against Gale
summary: Trains the thrower to hold a bearing through a howling gale, from the leaning stance to the unbent dart.

title: Plateau Master's Book of the Long Throw
summary: Gathers the master's long throw, with pacing, upslope casts and a dart sent to the edge of range.

title: Canon of the Wind-Carried Dart
summary: Shows a Xiantian thrower how to link qi with moving air so the dart rides the wind to its mark.

title: Book of the Core Gale Cast
summary: Gives a Core thrower the plateau's gale and the formed core together, from the rooted stance to the storming cast.
